Cheesey Rice Krispies
By: Diethood
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:02am

Ingredients




2 cups shredded mild or sharp cheese
1 cup butter, softened
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 cups of Rice Krispies cereal

Preparation

1 Preheat oven at 375 degrees. 2 Combine cheese, butter, add flour and mix well. 3 Add Rice Krispies cereal. 
 4 Shape into balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
 5 Flatten each ball with a fork and bake for 10 minutes. 6 Allow to cool before serving.
